extracted.name: Better-Than-Taco Bell Mexican Pizza
extracted.description: This better-than-Taco Bell Mexican pizza recipe is made with Mexican-seasoned ground beef, refried beans, and cheese, all served over flour tortillas.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Heat oil in a deep skillet over high heat: cook each tortilla in skillet, turning frequently, until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels.
Place 4 tortillas on a baking sheet. Spread 3 tablespoons of refried beans evenly on top: add 2 to 3 tablespoons ground beef. Top with remaining 4 tortillas.
Mix taco sauce and enchilada sauce together in a small bowl: spoon 2 tablespoons on top of the tortillas evenly. Sprinkle ¼ cup of each type of cheese evenly on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted, 3 to 4 minutes. Top with diced tomatoes, black olives, and green onions. Cut into quarters: serve immediately.
